title: Account
subtitle: Manage your name, email, password, and active sessions.

email.heading: Email
email.confirmationSentDescription: Check {{email}} and click the link to finish changing your email.

password.heading: Password
password.revokeOtherSessions: Sign out of all other devices

sessions.heading: Sessions

sessions.revokeAllConfirmDescription: You'll be signed out on every other device. This one stays signed in.

apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time you'll see the full key - store it somewhere safe.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Anything using this key will immediately lose access.
